summary: If a collection role uses a local custom module whose short name conflicts with a collection module, call it as ansible.legacy.<name>.
questions: How does a collection role call a local custom module instead of a same-named collection module?

answer_card.title: Use ansible.legacy for local modules in collection roles
answer_card.answer_md: Change `local_module_name` to `ansible.legacy.local_module_name` in the tasks to make sure the local custom module is used.
